raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-17 the source no longer updates the original record to REVERSED. It sends a separate REVERSAL row with orig_txn_id pointing at the original, so the original stays POSTED and is still counted. This inflates gold totals for the most recent days. The fix excludes POSTED originals that have a matching REVERSAL row. The REVERSAL rows are already excluded by the status filter, which matches how REVERSED originals were treated before.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id);"}}
